status: candidate dataset generated; scientific design and species/domain acceptance remain provisional
decision_status: implementation configuration executed; shared scientific review pending
method: Species-specific presence/background examples on actual Bio-ORACLE grid centres.

target_interpretation.label_1: A recorded, verified focal-species presence aggregated to one species/cell/period row.
target_interpretation.label_0: A sampled marine environmental grid cell with no recorded presence of that same AphiaID in any input period; it is background, not confirmed biological absence.
target_interpretation.probability_claim: Classifier scores against these constructed labels are not automatically calibrated occurrence probabilities.

sampling.sampling: Uniform without replacement from eligible GSHHG-water Bio-ORACLE raster centres.
sampling.protected_presence_policy: Protect every absence=false input cell for the focal AphiaID across all periods, even when a row is excluded from positive labels for incomplete taxonRank or other eligibility fields.
sampling.sampling_domain: Intersection of the verified GSHHG marine-water geometry and actual Bio-ORACLE grid centres with all six core environmental values; no EEZ clipping or effort-matching weights are applied.

source_metadata_issues: 2020-2026 samples use Bio-ORACLE SSP245 2020 values as a projection-based temporal assumption, not annual observed conditions.
Baseline products are decadal summaries; exact averaging windows remain unresolved for some products in the existing integration record.
Integration-catalogue quarantines remain null; no missing or quarantined measurement is replaced with zero or an invented value.

environmental_value_checks.scale_offset_handling: netCDF4 automatic masking/scaling is enabled for source reads; Script 08's harmonizer operates on already-decoded values; no scale_factor or add_offset is applied again.

reproducibility.content_hash_method: pandas row-content hash over all output columns plus WKB geometry; excludes Parquet file metadata.

limitations: OBIS presence locations reflect uneven reporting and sampling effort; this construction does not correct that bias.
Uniform background sampling does not model species-specific accessible area or OBIS effort and may create geographic/environmental separation from observed presences.
The water domain is GSHHG marine water intersected with the Bio-ORACLE collection grid, not a final Sri Lankan EEZ or species-specific accessible-area boundary.

Policy B retained points despite some known coordinate-uncertainty footprints crossing coast/land or extending beyond reference coverage; source uncertainty categories remain attached to contributing records.
Repeated records are collapsed within species/cell/period, but the same cell can occur in different periods. Future splits must group shared cells and assess temporal leakage.
Only six core features are required for candidate eligibility. The remaining 376 feature definitions may be missing or quarantined; no imputation is performed.
SSP245 2020 is used for 2020-2026 as a projection-based assumption; baseline time-window metadata remains imperfect.
Some sampled background cells may contain unrecorded true presences. Label 0 is not a confirmed absence.
The ten-cell gate is only a construction eligibility check and does not establish enough independent locations for reliable spatial evaluation; Stenella longirostris is especially sparse.
Future model evaluation requires spatially isolated folds that prevent shared-cell leakage; no partition, feature selection, imputation, normalization or model fit is included.
The three focal taxa are initial candidates only; the output does not establish that all 501 observed species are modelable or that these are final group-selected species.

readiness.descriptive_eda: Ready, subject to the limits above and retained quarantine/missingness fields.
readiness.supervised_preprocessing_input: Ready as a candidate input for a later agreed and leakage-aware preprocessing stage; all 382 features still require review and missing-value handling.
readiness.model_training: Not approved by this output alone; shared target/domain review, feature selection, preprocessing and spatial validation design remain required.
